messages:
Sofia (PM): Heads-up: need plan for Q3 model switch for EU+NA with customer opt-ins. Proposal: micro-mirror canary with weighted rollout + metric-driven auto-increase. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Ben (Eng): +1. Suggest start with 0.5% mirror, 1% live for canary tenants, 3% shadow sampling for new cohorts.
Maria (SRE): Ops constraint: cache invalidation across edge CDN when flag flips. If we flip flags globally, we'll get cache storms. Need stagger windows per-region.
Ben (Eng): Agreed. Gate flag flips by region + hour. Metric gating: error_rate < 1% and p95_latency < 200ms over a 15m window before any bump.
Ravi (Infra): Autoscale cooldown needs 10m after each bump or we'll get thrash. Add minimum dwell time and a rollback hook.
Sofia (PM): Customer ask: AcmeCorp needs day-1 beta and per-tenant guaranteed fallback to previous model.
Ben (Eng): We can use tenant-scoped flags + kill-switch. Example config:
```yaml
flag: model_v2
scopes:
  - tenants: ["acme"]
  - regions: ["eu-west-1"]
weights:
  baseline: 0
  canary: 1
  ramp: [1,5,10]
dwell_minutes: 30
metrics: ["error_rate","p95_latency"]
```
Maria (SRE): Ops playbook must include: disable flag, revert route, clear edge cache, notify customer. I'll draft and attach the runbook.
rollout-bot: Canary started: flag model_v2 set to 1% for tenant "acme" in eu-west-1 at 2026-08-15T10:01Z
Ben (Eng): Do we need an A/B measurement window? Product wants conversion delta tracked — suggest 24h minimum sample per cohort.
Sofia (PM): Yes. Gate on quality monitors + experiment thresholds: no negative conversion delta > 0.5% for 24h and no p95 regressions. Assign experiment_id in analytics.
Maria (SRE): Add automatic rollback: if error_rate increases > 0.75% over baseline within 15m, trigger rollback and notify #release-alerts with webhook.
Ravi (Infra): I'll wire metric hooks into the autoswap lambda and set a hard cap at 30% global shift until steady state.
Ben (Eng): I'll open the PR for rollout config + unit tests: flag toggle semantics, tenant isolation, mirrored logging.
Sofia (PM): Timeline: start mirror Tue AM, canary Wed, ramp Thurs/Fri if green. I'll send customer comms and page the SREs for the canary window. :rocket:
